sloka: गजा मदोत्कटाः शूराश्चलन्त इव पर्वताः ।ते युद्धकुशलै रूढास्तोमराङ्कुशपाणिभिः ।। ६.५३.१० ।।।।
transliteration: gajā madotkaṭāḥ śūrāścalanta iva parvatāḥ ।te yuddhakuśalai rūḍhāstomarāṅkuśapāṇibhiḥ ।। 6.53.10 ।।।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasa leaders decorated with lovely raiment, glowing, the heroes moved like mountains. They seemed like elephants intoxicated with ichor.
